balls.text: Dropped and parried into the boundary. Sums up the first half for MI. This seems like the slower short ball wide of off. Rayudu waits for it to arrive, leans back, and cuts it uppishly in the air. Surya moves across to his left from sweeper cover and shells it
whacked over the MI dug-out for six. Rayudu ventures across off stump, Kulkarni misses the yorker. Rayudu lines up this full-toss and slogs it away over square leg
pretty full and wide once again from Kulkarni. Rayudu gives himself some room. Slashes and misses as Kulkarni takes it away from his reach
wide yorker, Jadeja mis-hits a sweep to wide long-on
full and wide, Kulkarni pushes it past the tram-line. Off-side wide
low full-toss on middle, hauled away to the right of Pollard at wide long-on
low full-toss outside off, Jadeja drags a slog-sweep to deep midwicket
middle-stump full-toss, which is whipped to deep midwicket. Bumrah finishes with 1 for 56 - his most expensive IPL spell
Jadeja crouches low, Bumrah just misses the yorker once again. Very full and sliding down the leg side, Jadeja flicks it away fine and pushes CSK past 200
Rayudu shuffles across off, another full-toss outside off at 145ks, as Bumrah misses the yorker. Plinked to long-on
Jadeja feigns to shift outside leg, Bumrah follows him with a yorker, which is clipped to deep square leg
Rayudu shuffles across off, meets a 145ks full-toss and swings it away between deep midwicket and wide long-on
low full-toss on middle and leg, whisked away to wide long-on
Jadeja shifts outside leg, Bumrah follows him and fires a leg-side wide
carved over cover-point for six. Great intent and hitting from Rayudu. He backs away outside leg, Bout goes full, Rayudu gets underneath the length and clears the off-side boundary
Rayudu slinks around his crease and throws Boult off his line. Leg-side wide
Rayudu surges to a 20-ball half-century. On a length and on off, bad length at this point of the innings. Rayudu clears his front leg and belts it straight of long-off
slower ball, short and into the pitch. Rayudu, standing outside leg, delays the pull and then muscles it over midwicket for another six
hoicked away to wide long-on
Rayudu shuffles outside leg, Boult chases the moving batsman and strikes the pad. He crosses over for the leg bye
full and outside off, Jadeja crouches and belts it straight of wide long-off
yorker on off or just a shade outside off. Rayudu swings for the hills and inside-edges it away from short fine leg for four. 21 off that Bumrah over

Bumrah just misses his length. The line is outside off. Rayudu lays into it and crunnnnnnnches it over extra-cover for six. More bad news for MI: the no-ball siren goes off. Free-hit coming for Rayudu
really full on off, whipped with the angle through the leg side
on a length on middle at 140ks, glided more or less straight to short third man
very full and darted down the leg side for a wide
first boundary for Jadeja. He rides the bounce of this short ball angled into him and dinks it between the keeper and short third man
full-toss on middle, Rayudu flaps it away to deep midwicket. Just a single for the batter
very full and on the pads, clipped to deep square leg
launched straight over Kulkarni's head for another towering six. Slower ball outside off from the seamer, Rayudu uses his feet again and smites it down the ground
pumped over long-on for six. Rayudu races down the track, manufactures his own length - full-toss - and carts it over the boundary
wide yorker, dug out to extra-cover. Excellent bowling from Kulkarni
slower bumper outside off, wide called for height
tap and run to short third man
111.7ks slower ball outside off. Jadeja crouches low, waits for this variation, then whips to deep midwicket
very full and angling into off, pushed down to Pollard manning the long-on boundary
fired on middle stump, Rayudu drives a single down to long-off
pushed through on off stump, blocked to cover off the front foot
attempted wrong'un from Chahar. He drags it down on middle stump. Rayudu rocks into a back-foot pull and pummels it over square leg for a masssssive six
shorter and sliding across Jadeja. He goes on the back foot and cracks it to sweeper cover
back of a length and spinning down the leg side for a wide
googly, fizzing outside off past the outside edge
fractionally short and on the hips, Rayudu tucks it away to long leg
on a length and outside off, clipped through midwicket. Another excellent over from Pollard. He makes things happen - both with bat and ball
stabbed back to the bowler
back of a length and outside off, Rayudu camps back, opens the face and glides it through backward point

Another tough return chance, this time Pollard drops it. Back of a length, into the pitch, and stops on Jadeja. He checks his drive and spoons it in the air. Pollard dives to his left from the followthrough, but it doesn't stick
Jadeja shuffles down the track, Pollard shoves a full-toss down the leg side as he loses control of the ball

Pollard spins around for an lbw appeal and that's given. Jadeja calls for a review. Nice and full on middle, Jadeja plays around it and seems to have hit it before the ball strikes the back pad. No inside edge, but it had pitched outside leg
slower ball, on a length and outside off. Rayudu drives to sweeper cover and averts the hat-trick
darted into leg stump or outside, Jadeja misses the sweep and wears it on the pad
on a fuller side of a good length and spins into middle. Jadeja plays back and works it to square leg
short, wide, googly, which is carved straight to extra-cover
on a length and spinning down the leg side, did that graze the thigh pad? Not given wide
back of a length and spins away outside off, punched off the back foot to the right of Chahar
tossed up on the pads, picked away through backward square leg

Pollard wheels away in celebration. Catch him if you can. 107ks cutter outside off. Raina aims to manufacture some pace of his own, but does not middle this. Heaved to Krunal at deep midwicket. Raina holes out for 2 in his 200th IPL match

Golden arm: Pollard. Fine leg is inside the circle, so Faf goes for the ramp, but picks out Bumrah. Faf shuffles across off even before Pollard delivers this offcutter. The lack of pace does Faf in. He miscues it in the air. Bumrah lunges forward, snatches at the ball, and just about hangs onto it
clipped through backward square leg
wide of the crease, wobbles into the pads, tucked away to Neesham at deep square once again. Faf brings up a 27-ball half-century to extend his form
hip-high short ball outside off, Raina hoicks it away to deep midwicket
nice and full on middle, tucked away to Neesham at deep square leg
lifter, angling into the body of Raina. He hops and fends it off

Bumrah comes back and takes out Moeen! Dug in short, slanting into Moeen from around the wicket, cramping Moeen. The batter aims to lean back and ramp it over de Kock. It's quick and close to his body, so he can only guide it into the gloves of the keeper
pretty full and outside off, 143ks, slashed through the line to sweeper cover
wide yorker, Faf jams his bat down and slices it off the outer half between the keeper and short third man
banged in shorter and outside off at 142ks, this gets big on Faf. He still dares to hook it over midwicket for another boundary
....and Faf welcomes him back with a six. Short and slanting into middle with the exaggerated angle of Bumrah. Blameless delivery, Faf makes it look bad by pulling a six over midwicket
scythed over cover-point for a one bounce four. Short ball into the pitch and angling away from Moeen. He throws his hands and hips into the ball to put that away in grand style
full-toss outside off, Neesham lines it up and whacks it down the ground to the left of wide long-off
dug in short on middle, Faf backs away and glides a single to third man

full-toss on middle and leg, whipped away between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Faf hares back for the second. He slides his bat. De Kock disturbs one bail and lights it up even before collecting the ball. Then, he gathers the ball cleanly and flips the other bail off. Tight call. the TV umpire Gaffney reckons Faf has slid his bat in time. "Very tight call," says MI coach Mahela
Valimai update: Moeen Ali raises his maiden fifty for CSK. Cutter into the pitch, wide of off, hauled away to square leg off the inner half
such a smooth swing from Moeen. Another slower ball attempted by Neesham. Moeen reads it and clatters it over midwicket
pummeled over midwicket. Dragged down on middle, slider from Chahar. Faf rocks into a back-foot pull and nails it over the leg side. 16 off the over
back of a length and skids into middle and leg, Moeen clears his front leg and hauls the ball away to long-on
dropped short and breaks away outside off, Faf forces it to the right of Neesham at sweeper cover
Moeen jumps back to this short slider on middle and pulls it on the bounce to deep midwicket
Moeen makes some room, skips out of the crease, takes this full ball from outside off and laces it over wide long-off for six.
Faf skips away outside leg, Chahar follows him with a short dart, which is hauled away to deep square leg
off-stump yorker, good execution from Neesham, dug out back to him
slower ball, dips outside off, 112.5ks, drilled straight to extra-cover

Neesham drops a difficult return catch. 114.8ks, cutter, into the pitch, messes with Faf's drive. Jabbed in the air. Neesham lunges to his right from his followthrough, but the ball pops out of his right-hand
pretty full on the pads, this on-pace ball is chipped straight to Krunal at deep midwicket. Moeen inspects the toe end of his bat
pulled over midwicket. Krunal leaps in vain. Hip-high short cutter outside off. Moeen swivels into it and puts it away
full and angling across off, crunnnnnnnnched straight to extra-cover
back of a length and on the hips, tucked away to deep midwicket. Just four off the over. Good one from Chahar
starts outside leg, as Moeen attempts a big slog-sweep, brushes the pad and bounces up into the gloves of de Kock
whipped off the pads through backward square leg
Moeen uses his feet, Chahar drags his length back and takes another googly away from the left-hander. Squeezed through extra-cover
back of a length googly, Moeen defends it back off the back foot
on a length and slides in at off, Faf camps back and secures a single to the leg side
Another inswinging yorker, Boult hits the pad, but this is slipping down leg once again
Boult goes for another yorker, comes out as a low full-toss on the pads. Flicked firmly to deep backward square leg, where Krunal overruns and gives up a four
banged in short and veering away outside off, Moeen wafts and misses in the channel

pretty full on middle and leg, Faf clips it straight to midwicket. Moeen is interested in a risky single, but is sent back. He dives full-length and that saves him. Suryakumar, I think, throws the stumps down and CSK ultimately get a single via a ricochet
inswinging yorker from Boult, Moeen digs it out. Given as leg-bye. It was anyway heading down leg with that sharp angle and sharper swing
Faf steps out, drags a middle-stump full-toss to short fine leg off the inner half
Faf rocks into a back-foot pull and strokes this short ball away to deep square leg
Bumrah immediately drags his length back and thumps the thigh pad. Leg bye
sweet as... Bumrah goes for the slower cutter, overpitches it and strays on the pads. Moeen picks up this offcutter and lifts it over square leg for six
...but this isn't as short. Back of a length and outside off, punched straight to mid-off off the back foot
much fuller and skidding into middle and leg, Faf stoops low and whips it away to the leg-side sweeper
good length and angling into off and middle, Faf drives straight to cover-point
after a brace of yorkers, Kulkarni goes for a slower ball outside off. It comes out as a full-toss, which is hauled away past the left of midwicket by Moeen
another quick yorker at 136ks, this one aims for off stump, jammed out to mid-off
yorker from Kulkarni, 136ks, pitches outside leg and swerves to ping him low on the pad. Moeen topples over
short and slanting across Moeen, slower-ball bouncer, Moeen drops his gloves and ignores it
back of a length and outside off, driven past the left of the bowler and right of long-off
short and into Moeen's body, he toe-ends a pull down to long leg
back of a length and climbs over the stumps at 139ks. Faf, having jumped across off, can't meet with the flick
bouncer aimed at Moeen's body. He pulls in the air...but lands in front of Bumrah at deep midwicket. The outfielder elects to hang back instead of rushing in to attack it
punched over mid-off this time. On a length and largely holds his line outside off, Moeen checks his punch and handsomely chips it over the infielder
nonchalantly picked off the hips for six. Shortish and on the hips, Moeen uses the angle to his advantage and dispatches it over square leg
just short of a good length and outside off, Moeen checks his punch now and plays it more or less straight to mid-on. He's usually a fast starter, but is now on 0 off 4 balls
guided from a middle-stump line to short third man, where Bumrah makes a sprawling save. Faf manages to get across to the other end
back of a length, pops up at Moeen from there and stops on him. Moeen checks his flick and chips it in front of midwicket
on a length and largely holds its line outside off, slower ball, which is driven through the line to the left of long-off
full inswinger, driven off the front foot from a middle-stump line to mid-on
pumped over mid-off for six. Faf dashes out of the crease, meets this full ball early outside off, and launches it with great authority
Kulkarni hits a hard length, on off, neither cuttable nor pullable. No room either. Jabbed to cover
a bit too full and straight, the fine leg is in the outfield for Faf's scoop. This time he simply picks it away fine of that outfielder for four
Boult challenges the outside edge with the outswinger. On a length, shifts his lines wider of off and gets it to bend away. A crease-bound Moeen drives...and misses in the channel
length-ball inswinger from Boult, from left-arm over, does not threaten off. Left alone

leading-edged to Hardik at point. Fuller side of a good length on middle, no real movement in the air or off the seam. Gaikwad aims leg side, but closes the bat-face a touch early and spoons a catch to the infielder
Boult drags his length back and shifts his line to middle. Gaikwad presses forward to defensively bunt it to the covers
sweet as.... Overpitched and outside off, Gaikwad leans into the cover-drive and caresses it through the off side. So very stylish
back of a length and slanting away outside off, the ball doesn't quite come onto the bat. Gaikwad waits and then dabs to slip with soft hands

Pollard wins it for MI in a blockbuster finish! Kulkarni tears back for the second. This was a good ball, though, from Ngidi. Into the blockhole outside off, Pollard hastily brings his bat down and jams it down the ground. Faf is at straight long-on and has to move across to his right to hunt it down. There's enough time for Pollard to scamper back for the second
rifled away in the air to the right of Thakur at deep square leg for six. On-pace full-toss on middle at 140ks, Pollard puts it away with all his might

misses the yorker once again, full-toss on middle stump. Pollard swipes it away in the air over the leg side. Thakur runs in from deep square leg, goes for the catch, but the ball bounces in front of him. He puts his body behind the ball and saves it. Pollard keeps strike, though
terrible ball from Ngidi. The attempted yorker comes out as a high full-toss down the leg side, but it dips below the waist, shovelled away with the bottom wrist fine of long leg for four

well bowled by Ngidi, but Pollard squirts it through his legs for four. Middle-stump yorker, bending into Pollard. He inside-edges it through his legs to the right of deep square leg. Ngidi can't believe this
low full-toss, angling into off, hoicked away to Thakur at deep square leg. Pollard doesn't take the single on offer. He knows he can do it by himself. He has done it in the past

Lapped straight to Thakur running to his left from deep square leg. Low full-toss on middle, fine leg is inside the circle, so Neesham looks to scoop it over that infielder. Instead, he hits it squarer to Thakur
searing yorker on middle, 139.2ks, Pollard hastily jabs an inside edge behind square on the leg side

Faf slides to his right from wide long-off and holds onto this catch. Is this game still on? Curran errs with his length once again. He offers up a slot ball outside off, Hardik aims for a lofted drive, but only slices it in the air
leg-stump yorker, squirted through midwicket. Hardik calls for the double and gets it
swiped over square leg for six. Short and into the hips, Curran gets it wrong once again. Hardik tees off once again
blasted over long-off for six. On a length and outside off, slower one from the left-arm seamer. Hardik gets it off the bottom of the bat but still clears the fence
slower short ball outside off, Pollard swipes and misses it outside off
slower bumper outside off, wide called for height

Wouldja believe that? Faf du Plessis, one the best outfielders in the world, drops it at long-on. He runs in, slides to his right, but can only finger-tip it into the ground. Is that the game? Shorter and outside off, Pollard flat-bats it down the ground and gets away with it. Faf buries his head into the ground
Pollard fetches a short ball from outside off and muscles a pull just wide of Jadeja at deep midwicket
better length, but Pollard still packs enough power behind that to find the fence. Just short of a yorker length outside off, belted to the right of long-off
thrashed straight of Faf at straight long-on. On a length and outside off, wrong length from Thakur. Pollard makes it look worse by bludgeoning it down the ground

back of a length and darted past the tramline. Another off-side wide. Pollard swishes outside off...and misses. Oh hang on, Rayudu thinks Pollard is gone. He seems to have coaxed Dhoni into a review. Flat line on Ultra Edge. No bat involved at all
just short of a length and outside off, Hardik hoicks it away to the right of long-on. Faf slides to his right and makes a fine save
full on the pads, on-pace slot ball, hits the pad and rolls back to Curran. He got away with that in isolation. But, overall, exceptional over from Curran
mighty full on middle and leg, Curran just misses the yorker, driven down to long-on
slower ball, rolled across off, Hardik swishes and misses in the channel
Curran: makes things happen. Into the blockhole from wide of the crease, plunges at Krunal and pings the boot bang in front. Great execution under pressure from Curran
full and wide, Curran takes it away from Pollard, but finishes inside the tramline. Toe-ended to extra-cover
top yorker from Curran, into the blockhole, dug out by Pollard
Gaikwad runs across to his left from deep midwicket, misjudges this skier, and gives up four. Slower offcutter on off, Kruna top-edges a pull, which is dropped by Gaikwad in the outfield
banged in short and angling into the body at 139.3ks, pulled along the ground to the right of deep square
Ngidi tries the wide yorker, sliced away to the right of Jadeja at sweeper cover
wrong line and length from Ngidi once again. Short and shoved down the leg side, tickled away between Dhoni and short fine leg. Misdirects the slower one and cops punishment
slower ball, 114ks, and pushed across Krunal. He swings way too early...and misses
banged in short at the body and rushes Krunal into a hook. Wrong length. He top-edges it over the fine-leg boundary
short and skidding into off at 143ks, chopped away hastily to the right of sweeper cover
better length from Thakur. He pounds it on a heavy length and closer to off, hauled away to Curran at straight long-on
another off-side wide from Thakur

dug in short and outside off, Pollard swivels into a pull and dispatches this slower ball to the square-leg boundary. Pollard charges to a 17-ball half-century - the fastest in IPL 2021 and the fastest ever vs CSK
nicked between Dhoni and short third man. Back of a length and outside off, Pollard swishes at it. The outside edge streaks past the right of Dhoni
full and wide again from Thakur, he floats it past the tramline once again. Pollard's assault has stunned the CSK bowlers
full and wide of off, think that was the initial plan from Thakur. Pollard reaches out and carves it to extra-cover, where Moeen, I think, dives and lets the ball through for four
This is incredible power-hitting from Pollard. On a length and outside off, right in the batter's swinging arc. Pollard extends his hands and muscles it away into the top tier
full and wide of off, Thakur takes this away from Pollard's reach. It ends up being an off-side wide
shorter and outside off at 138ks, wafted into the covers for one
Pollard hasn't middled that, but still gets enough power to clear straight long-on. Fuller and outside off, Pollard clears his front leg and lofts it away
Pollard smites it over midwicket for six. Back of a length and sits up outside off. Pollard reads the slower ball and powers it away over the leg side
another slower ball, 115.1ks, on a heavy length and outside off. Sliced in the air, but wide of extra-cover
Ngidi hits a hard length outside off and cuts down his pace. Hauled across the line to deep midwicket
slower ball, short of a length and into the leg stump. Krunal pulls early and inside-edges onto the pad
on a length and Jadeja brings this back into the line of the stumps. Long-on is straight for Pollard and he clears him with ridiculous ease. Bam! This is serious hitting from Pollard
smeared over the outfielder and into CSK's dug-out. Pollard collapses his back knee, takes this from outside off, and clears sweeper cover
Pollard gives himself room room, darted wide of off, inside-edged behind to Dhoni
walloped over wide long-off for a towering six. Pitched up and wide of off, Pollard manufactures additional room and swings lustily through the line
flatter and faster on the pads, slog-swept away to long leg
Pollard shifts outside leg and belted it back to Jadeja. The brute force of the shot means the ball bursts through the hands of the bowler. Long-on is straight to hunt it down
Pollard comes down the track, yorks himself, and ends up squirting a single into the leg side
full and sliding across off, Krunal looks to drive through extra-cover, instead carves it squarer to Jadeja at sweeper cover
just short of a good length and just a shade outside off, slapped away to the left of Jadeja at sweeper cover
slower bouncer, floated wide of off, Pandya can't touch this either
back of a length and skidding through closer to off, as Krunal swings lustily to the leg side and misses
pumped into the sightscreen. On a length and angling away outside off, seam-up, Pandya stays still and hoists it down the ground
fizzing across off at 106ks, hacked down to long-on
Pollard shifts outside leg, Jadeja follows him with a short dart which is punched to Gowtham at straight long-on
shorter and on the hips, short-armed away to deep square leg off the back foot
back of a length and slid across off at 100.1ks, jabbed into the covers
Krunal searches for a reverse-sweep, Jadeja fires it on leg stump, he checks his shot and gloves it onto the ground before it pops up to Dhoni
Krunal uses his feet, Jadeja bangs it shorter and wider of off. Stabbed to mid-off
back of a length and angling into middle, Pollard camps back and plays it to the right of Moeen again
fuller and slides into middle, defended back to the right of Moeen
Spooned back to Moeen. Make that three wickets in three overs for CSK. Nicely bowled, dipping into a fuller length on middle, de Kock closes the bat-face early and chips a leading-edge back to Moeen
balls.dismissal: Q de Kock — caught and bowled

balls.text: pushed through on a length and just outside off, played back to Moeen
down the track and wafted into the leg side
nice and full, slides in from round the wicket to ping the pad, but this is going down leg
worked through square leg
speared on middle and leg, full, whisked to long-on

Two in two overs for CSK. Jadeja has Surya nicking off this time. Pushed through on a length, 99ks and spins away just enough outside off. Surya chucks his hands at the ball and nicks it behind to Dhoni who snags a low catch
darted into the pads, clipped away to the left of the leg umpire
pushed through outside off, Surya splices a slog-sweep to the right of deep square leg
back of a length and spinning into middle and leg, forced off the back foot to wide long-on
back of a length and angling into middle and leg, punched away between Jadeja (deep midwicket) and Faf (wide long-on). Impressive start from Thakur
back of a length and skidding in to thud into the pad and roll away behind

Thakur strikes in his first over to have Rohit holing out to Gaikwad at sweeper cover. Slightly back of a length and around off stump, Rohit aims to pump it over extra-cover. Instead, he slices it squarer to Gaikwad
De Kock jumps across off and whips this slower ball from outside off to the left of midwicket and right of the leg-side sweeper. Good work from Gaikwad in the deep
full on middle and leg, clipped away to the left of Jadeja at deep midwicket now
short and wide of off, slapped away to the left of Jadeja at sweeper cover
whipped from outside off to wide long-on. A fumble from Thakur allows the second. Rohit had called for the second anyway. The misfield made it just easier for MI
slower ball wobbling down the leg side
on a length from Chahar, angling in towards off. Rohit plays for the incoming angle but it straightens away past the outside edge to open up the batter
dug in shorter and outside off, de Kock pulls it away to the left of Jadeja at deep midwicket
full-toss on middle stump, Chahar cops punishment. de Kock twirls his wrists and whips it away through backward square leg
slower ball on off and middle, clipped through square leg
fullish and outside off, de Kock pushes a single down the ground
slower ball, pushed wide of off, Ngidi keeps de Kock to a single to mid-off
shortish and angling across off stump, de Kock has a crack at it and swats it away to the left of Ngidi and right of Curran at mid-on
just short of a good length and skidding into off stump to draw an inside-edged waft to the leg side
back of a length and outside off, slower ball, Ngidi delays his drive and slices it through point
Ngidi digs it shorter and attacks Rohit's body, spliced into the leg side
lofted over mid-on for six. Pitched up and outside off, lands in Rohit's swing arc. He holds his shape and smacks it over the top. New ball, please
full inswinger on off, tucked away to deep midwicket
slower short ball wide of off. Hauled away straight to Moeen at midwicket
back of a length and on the stumps, 119.9ks slower ball, reverse-swatted straight to Ngidi at short third man
really full and outside off, de Kock can't get underneath the length. Off the inner edge to Moeen at midwicket
a bit too full and angling into middle and leg, sweetly flicked to deep midwicket
toe-ended over square leg. De Kock jumps across off, Chahar cuts his pace and forces the batter to wait for his pull
low full-toss on off, stroked straight to mid-on
slower cutter on the stumps, 91.2ks, hip-high ball. Rohit mis-hits a pull over midwicket. Moeen chases hard in vain
Rohit steps out at Curran. The left-arm seamers drags it shorter and wider of off. Rohit has a roundhouse swipe at it and top-edges over short third man
not quite short enough for the pull and the line is on off. Rohit splices a pull back to Curran
fuller and into the pads, glanced to Thakur at long leg
short of a length and slanting away outside off, Rohit jumps on top of the bounce and punches to the left of sweeper cover
back of a length and outside off, de Kock jumps across off and manufactures a six. Shovels it off the fine-leg fence off the top-edge
nice and full again, swings in, clipped through midwicket

given out lbw! Rohit chats with de Kock and calls for a review of the on-field out decision. Nice and full, angling in and swinging away just enough to beat the outside edge and ping the back pad. Okay, Ultra Edge detects a spike. Rohit has hit it. Umpire Ananthapadmanabhan has to reverse his decision. If he'd hit it, why did Rohit not review immediately? Probably he wasn't sure either. Good call in the end from both him and de Kock
much fuller and homing in at off stump, Rohit covers up and plays it back to the bowler
